WITH "totals" AS (SELECT "c".segment, "ym".customerid, SUM("ym".consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "ym" ON "ym".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'CZK' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND "ym".date >= '2013-01-01' AND "ym".date < '2014-01-01' GROUP BY "c".segment, "ym".customerid), "lowest" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (segment) segment, customerid, total_consumption FROM "totals" ORDER BY segment ASC, total_consumption ASC, customerid ASC) SELECT ROUND((MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME') - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "SME minus LAM", ROUND((MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM') - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "LAM minus KAM", ROUND((MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM') - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "KAM minus SME" FROM "lowest" LIMIT 501

WITH "yearly" AS (SELECT "c".segment, LEFT("y".date, 4) AS "yr", SUM("y".consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" AS "y" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "y".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'EUR' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND LEFT("y".date, 4) IN ('2012', '2013') GROUP BY "c".segment, LEFT("y".date, 4)), "increases" AS (SELECT segment, 100.0 * (MAX(CASE WHEN yr = '2013' THEN total_consumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN yr = '2012' THEN total_consumption END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN yr = '2012' THEN total_consumption END) AS "increase_percentage" FROM "yearly" GROUP BY segment), "ranked" AS (SELECT segment, increase_percentage, MIN(increase_percentage) OVER () AS "lowest", MAX(increase_percentage) OVER () AS "highest" FROM "increases") SELECT segment, ROUND(increase_percentage::NUMERIC, 2) AS "increase_percentage" FROM "ranked" WHERE increase_percentage = highest OR increase_percentage = lowest ORDER BY increase_percentage DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) = 1997 THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) = 1996 THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) = 1996 THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "percentage_growth" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "a".account_id = "dp".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id AND "c".gender = 'M' WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1998-01-01' LIMIT 501
SELECT "a".frequency, "o".k_symbol FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "order" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".account_id = 3 AND "o".amount = 3539 LIMIT 501

WITH "first_month" AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(date)) AS "month_start" FROM "account"), "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" CROSS JOIN "first_month" AS "fm" WHERE "a".date >= "fm".month_start AND "a".date < "fm".month_start + INTERVAL '1 month'), "district_populations" AS (SELECT "qd".district_id, "d".a4 AS "inhabitants" FROM "qualifying_districts" AS "qd" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "qd".district_id) SELECT district_id, inhabitants FROM "district_populations" WHERE inhabitants = (SELECT MAX(inhabitants) FROM "district_populations") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "t".trans_id) FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "t".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id WHERE "dp".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".gender = 'M' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01' AND "t".k_symbol = ' ' LIMIT 501

WITH "top_districts" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a8 FROM "district" AS "d" ORDER BY "d".a8 DESC LIMIT 5), "district_burden" AS (SELECT "td".district_id, "td".a2 AS "district_name", ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "l".status IN ('C', 'D') THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END), 0)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT("a".account_id), 0)) AS "average_active_loan_per_account" FROM "top_districts" AS "td" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "td".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "td".district_id, "td".a2) SELECT district_name, average_active_loan_per_account FROM "district_burden" WHERE average_active_loan_per_account = (SELECT MAX(average_active_loan_per_account) FROM "district_burden") LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", "l".amount FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND ("l".date + ("l".duration * INTERVAL '1 month') - INTERVAL '1 day') >= DATE '1995-12-31') SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS "total_approved_amount" FROM "qualifying" GROUP BY region HAVING SUM(amount) = (SELECT MAX(region_total) FROM (SELECT SUM(amount) AS "region_total" FROM "qualifying" GROUP BY region) AS "totals") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Bohemia' AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "t".bank = 'AB' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("x".salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_average_salary", COUNT(*) AS "district_count" FROM (SELECT "d"."district_id", "d"."a11" AS "salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a"."district_id" = "d"."district_id" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp"."account_id" = "a"."account_id" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c"."client_id" = "dp"."client_id" WHERE "d"."a3" = 'east Bohemia' AND "c"."birth_date" >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "c"."birth_date" < DATE '1990-01-01' GROUP BY "d"."district_id", "d"."a11") AS "x" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("x".average_salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_of_district_average_salaries" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "d".district_id, "d".a11 AS "average_salary" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".client_id = "c".client_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' LEFT JOIN "disp" AS "account_disp" ON "account_disp".account_id = "owner_disp".account_id LEFT JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "account_disp".disp_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a11, "owner_disp".disp_id HAVING COUNT("ca".card_id) = 0) AS "x" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_loans_per_account" FROM (SELECT "a".account_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "a".account_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01') AS "older_accounts" LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "older_accounts".account_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "t".trans_id) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS "household_payments", COUNT(DISTINCT "t".trans_id) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol <> 'SIPO' AND "t".k_symbol <> ' ') AS "other_purpose_payments" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "t".account_id = "d".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "d".client_id = "c".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01' AND "t".amount > 4000 LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date, SUM("l".amount) AS "total_amount_borrowed", COALESCE("cp".counterparty_count, 0) AS "outside_bank_counterparties", "od".a2 AS "owner_home_district", "od".a4 AS "district_population", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST("od".a4 AS BIGINT) DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "branch_d" ON "branch_d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "owner_client" ON "owner_client".client_id = "owner_disp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "od" ON "od".district_id = "owner_client".district_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) AS "counterparty_count" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".account_id) AS "cp" ON "cp".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "branch_d".a2 = 'Prachatice' GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".date, "cp".counterparty_count, "od".a2, "od".a4 ORDER BY CAST("od".a4 AS BIGINT) DESC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "gold_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "oc".gender, "od".account_id FROM "card" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "cd" ON "cd".disp_id = "c".disp_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "od" ON "od".account_id = "cd".account_id AND "od".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "oc" ON "oc".client_id = "od".client_id WHERE "c".type = 'gold'), "acct_bal" AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS "mean_balance" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id), "district_set" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "ga".gender, "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a8 AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "salary", "d".a12 AS "urban_ratio" FROM "gold_accounts" AS "ga" INNER JOIN "acct_bal" AS "ab" ON "ab".account_id = "ga".account_id AND "ab".mean_balance > 1000 INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "ga".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a8 > 100000), "stats" AS (SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS "district_count", MAX(inhabitants) AS "max_pop", ROUND(AVG(salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "avg_salary", ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "avg_urban_ratio" FROM "district_set" GROUP BY gender) SELECT CASE "s".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 'women' ELSE 'men' END AS "gender", "s".district_count, "ds".a2 AS "district", "ds".inhabitants, "s".avg_salary, "s".avg_urban_ratio FROM "stats" AS "s" INNER JOIN "district_set" AS "ds" ON "ds".gender = "s".gender AND "ds".inhabitants = "s".max_pop ORDER BY CASE "s".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, "ds".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".account_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "owner_disp".disp_id AND "c".type = 'gold' WHERE "d".a8 >= 250000), "pair_totals" AS (SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "eligible_accounts" AS "ea" ON "ea".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account) SELECT bank, account, payment_count, total_amount FROM "pair_totals" ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM("t".amount), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Pisek' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".k_symbol <> ' ' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_client_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c"."client_id", "c"."district_id" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp"."client_id" = "c"."client_id" WHERE "c"."gender" = 'F' AND "dp"."type" = 'OWNER' AND "dp"."disp_id" IN (SELECT "disp_id" FROM "card") AND "dp"."account_id" IN (SELECT "account_id" FROM "loan")), "district_set" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d"."district_id", "d"."a3" AS "region", "d"."a2" AS "district_name", "d"."a8" AS "inhabitants", "d"."a11" AS "salary", "d"."a12" AS "unemployment" FROM "eligible_client_districts" AS "e" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d"."district_id" = "e"."district_id") SELECT region, ROUND(AVG(salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary", ROUND(AVG(unemployment)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_1996_district_unemployment_rate", (ARRAY_AGG(district_name ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_name ASC))[1] AS "most_populous_district" FROM "district_set" GROUP BY region LIMIT 501

WITH "district_crimes" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", COUNT("t".trans_id) FILTER (WHERE "t".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01') AS "crime_count" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a3, "d".a4), "ranked" AS (SELECT district_id, district_name, crime_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, translate(lower(district_name), 'áčďéěíňóřšťúůýž', 'acdeeinorstuuyz') ASC) AS "rn" FROM "district_crimes" WHERE region = 'central Bohemia'), "selected" AS (SELECT * FROM "ranked" WHERE rn <= 3), "overall" AS (SELECT AVG(crime_count::NUMERIC) AS "avg_count" FROM "district_crimes"), "top_stats" AS (SELECT AVG(crime_count::NUMERIC) AS "avg_count" FROM "selected") SELECT district_name, crime_count, ROUND((SELECT avg_count FROM "top_stats"), 2) AS "three_district_average", ROUND((SELECT avg_count FROM "overall"), 2) AS "overall_average", ROUND((SELECT avg_count FROM "top_stats") - (SELECT avg_count FROM "overall"), 2) AS "difference" FROM "selected" ORDER BY rn ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "markets" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "ca"."type" AS "card_type", "d"."district_id", "d"."a2" AS "home_district", "d"."a11" AS "inhabitants" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp"."disp_id" = "ca"."disp_id" INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl"."client_id" = "dp"."client_id" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d"."district_id" = "cl"."district_id"), "minima" AS (SELECT card_type, MIN(inhabitants) AS "inhabitants" FROM "markets" GROUP BY card_type) SELECT "m".card_type, "m".home_district, "m".inhabitants FROM "markets" AS "m" INNER JOIN "minima" AS "x" ON "x".card_type = "m".card_type AND "x".inhabitants = "m".inhabitants ORDER BY CASE "m".card_type WHEN 'gold' THEN 1 WHEN 'classic' THEN 2 WHEN 'junior' THEN 3 END ASC, "m".home_district ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "target_region" AS (SELECT a3 FROM "district" WHERE a2 = 'Litomerice'), "opened" AS (SELECT account_id, district_id FROM "account" WHERE date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND date < DATE '1997-01-01'), "last_tx" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("t".account_id) "t".account_id, "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "opened" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY "t".account_id ASC, "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC), "account_balances" AS (SELECT "o".account_id, "o".district_id, "lt".balance FROM "opened" AS "o" INNER JOIN "last_tx" AS "lt" ON "lt".account_id = "o".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "o".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = (SELECT a3 FROM "target_region")) SELECT ROUND(AVG(balance)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "region_average" FROM "account_balances" LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".amount, "a".district_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC) AS "rn" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'), "district_set" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".district_id, "d".a8 AS "inhabitants" FROM "ranked" AS "r" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "r".district_id WHERE "r".rn <= 10) SELECT (SELECT district_id FROM "district_set" ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS "district_id", (SELECT inhabitants FROM "district_set" ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS "inhabitants", (SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "district_set" AS "ds" ON "ds".district_id = "d".district_id) AS "average_salary" LIMIT 501

WITH "withdrawals" AS (SELECT "account".district_id, SUM("trans".amount) AS "total_withdrawn" FROM "trans" INNER JOIN "account" ON "account".account_id = "trans".account_id WHERE "trans".type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY "account".district_id), "account_counts" AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS "n_accounts" FROM "account" GROUP BY district_id), "order_totals" AS (SELECT "account".district_id, SUM("order".amount) AS "total_order_debit" FROM "account" INNER JOIN "order" ON "order".account_id = "account".account_id GROUP BY "account".district_id), "district_metrics" AS (SELECT "district".a2 AS "district_name", "district".a3 AS "region", "district".a8 AS "population", "withdrawals".total_withdrawn, "withdrawals".total_withdrawn::NUMERIC / "district".a8 AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", COALESCE("order_totals".total_order_debit, 0)::NUMERIC / "account_counts".n_accounts AS "avg_order_debit" FROM "district" INNER JOIN "withdrawals" ON "withdrawals".district_id = "district".district_id INNER JOIN "account_counts" ON "account_counts".district_id = "district".district_id LEFT JOIN "order_totals" ON "order_totals".district_id = "district".district_id WHERE "district".a8 >= 100000) SELECT district_name, region, population, total_withdrawn, ROUND(withdrawals_per_inhabitant, 2) AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS "rank_by_withdrawals_per_inhabitant", ROUND(avg_order_debit, 2) AS "avg_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district_metrics" ORDER BY rank_by_withdrawals_per_inhabitant ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date, "a".frequency, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", CASE WHEN "c".district_id = "a".district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "is_home_district", "d".a12 AS "average_salary", COALESCE("l".status, 'none') AS "loan_repayment_status", COALESCE("l".amount, 0) AS "loan_amount", COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE(SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'PRIJEM'), 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE(SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ'), 0) AS "total_expense", COALESCE(SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'PRIJEM'), 0) - COALESCE(SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ'), 0) AS "net_balance", "region_clients".client_count AS "clients_in_region", "region_top".district_name AS "most_populous_district", "region_top".population AS "most_populous_district_inhabitants", "district_ranks".population_rank AS "account_district_population_rank" FROM "disp" AS "dp" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "client_count" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3) AS "region_clients" ON "region_clients".region = "d".a3 LEFT JOIN (SELECT region, district_name, population FROM (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "d".a3 ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT DESC) AS "rnk" FROM "district" AS "d") AS "p" WHERE rnk = 1) AS "region_top" ON "region_top".region = "d".a3 LEFT JOIN (SELECT district_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a4::BIGINT DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM "district") AS "district_ranks" ON "district_ranks".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "dp".client_id = 3541 GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".date, "a".frequency, "d".a2, "d".a3, "c".district_id, "d".a12, "l".status, "l".amount, "region_clients".client_count, "region_top".district_name, "region_top".population, "district_ranks".population_rank ORDER BY COUNT("t".trans_id) DESC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "district_account_lending" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "a".account_id, "a".date, COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0) AS "amount_lent" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "a".account_id, "a".date), "district_year" AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)::INTEGER AS "opening_year", district_id, COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", SUM(amount_lent) AS "amount_lent", SUM(amount_lent)::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) AS "amount_lent_per_account" FROM "district_account_lending" GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)::INTEGER, district_id) SELECT opening_year::TEXT AS "opening_year", SUM(accounts_opened) AS "accounts_opened", SUM(amount_lent) AS "total_amount_lent", ROUND(AVG(amount_lent_per_account), 2) AS "avg_district_amount_lent_per_account" FROM "district_year" GROUP BY opening_year ORDER BY opening_year ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".account_id, "l".amount, "l".date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".date ASC, "l".loan_id ASC) AS "rn" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'), "top_loans" AS (SELECT * FROM "ranked_loans" WHERE rn <= 10) SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "t".amount AS "approved_amount", "t".date AS "approval_date", "x".balance AS "end_of_day_balance" FROM "top_loans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "tr".balance FROM "trans" AS "tr" WHERE "tr".account_id = "t".account_id AND "tr".date <= "t".date ORDER BY "tr".date DESC, "tr".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "x" ON TRUE ORDER BY "t".amount DESC, "t".date ASC, "t".loan_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "issued_clients" AS (SELECT "cl".client_id, "cl".gender, "cl".birth_date, "ca"."type" AS "card_type", "ca".issued, "dp".account_id, "cl".district_id FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "ca".issued >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "ca".issued < DATE '1995-01-01'), "account_loans" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(loan_id) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS "total_amount_borrowed" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id), "client_profile" AS (SELECT "ic".client_id, "ic".gender, "ic".birth_date, "ic".card_type, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ic".issued)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ic".birth_date)::INTEGER AS "age_at_issue", COALESCE("al".number_of_loans, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("al".total_amount_borrowed, 0) AS "total_amount_borrowed", CASE WHEN COALESCE("al".number_of_loans, 0) > 0 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ic".issued)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ic".birth_date)::INTEGER < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' WHEN COALESCE("al".number_of_loans, 0) > 0 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ic".issued)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ic".birth_date)::INTEGER >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower' ELSE 'Non-borrower' END AS "borrower_classification", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a11 AS "district_average_salary" FROM "issued_clients" AS "ic" LEFT JOIN "account_loans" AS "al" ON "al".account_id = "ic".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "ic".district_id) SELECT client_id, gender, birth_date, card_type, age_at_issue, number_of_loans, total_amount_borrowed, borrower_classification, district_name, district_average_salary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY age_at_issue ASC) AS "age_rank_within_gender" FROM "client_profile" ORDER BY client_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "branch_name", COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "transaction_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Moravia' AND "t".date <= DATE '1998-10-14' AND "t".k_symbol = ' ' GROUP BY "d".a2 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".amount = 98832 AND "l".date = DATE '1996-01-03' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date < DATE '1996-01-03' GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".account_id) FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "a".district_id = 1 AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN "t".amount WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -"t".amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "net_interest_czk" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" WHERE "d".client_id = 2823) AND "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".k_symbol IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK') LIMIT 501

WITH "loan_regions" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, "l".amount, "l".duration, "l".payments, "l".status, "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a3 AS "region", "c".client_id, "c".birth_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "l".amount DESC) AS "amount_rank" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F'), "chosen" AS (SELECT * FROM "loan_regions" WHERE amount_rank <= 3), "account_stats" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'PRIJEM') AS "total_deposits" FROM "trans" AS "t" GROUP BY "t".account_id), "region_loans" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3), "region_salaries" AS (SELECT "d1".a3 AS "region", ROUND(AVG("d1".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "avg_district_salary" FROM "district" AS "d1" GROUP BY "d1".a3) SELECT "c".client_id, "c".amount AS "loan_amount", "c".duration AS "duration_months", ROUND(("c".payments * "c".duration)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_payments", ROUND(("c".payments * "c".duration - "c".amount)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "interest_paid", "c".status AS "loan_status", "c".district, "c".region, COALESCE("s".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", ROUND(COALESCE("s".total_deposits, 0)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_deposits", CASE WHEN COALESCE("s".total_deposits, 0) > 2 * "c".amount THEN 'High Income' WHEN COALESCE("s".total_deposits, 0) > "c".amount THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS "income_category", "rl".loan_count AS "region_loan_count", "rs".avg_district_salary, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "c".birth_date))::INTEGER AS "completed_age" FROM "chosen" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "account_stats" AS "s" ON "s".account_id = "c".account_id LEFT JOIN "region_loans" AS "rl" ON "rl".region = "c".region LEFT JOIN "region_salaries" AS "rs" ON "rs".region = "c".region ORDER BY "c".amount DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", COUNT(DISTINCT "d".district_id) AS "qualifying_district_count", SUM("d".a4::BIGINT) AS "combined_population", COUNT(DISTINCT "l".account_id) AS "qualifying_account_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "l".duration > 24 AND "l".date < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY "d".a3 ORDER BY combined_population DESC, region ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "qualifying_districts", SUM("account_counts".monthly_account_count) AS "total_monthly_statement_accounts", ROUND(AVG("account_counts".average_salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary" FROM (SELECT "d".district_id, COUNT("a".account_id) AS "monthly_account_count", "d".a11 AS "average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a8 >= 100000 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND "a".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a11) AS "account_counts" LIMIT 501

WITH "gold_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "card" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".disp_id = "c".disp_id WHERE "c".type = 'gold'), "transaction_totals" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'PRIJEM') AS "total_amount_received", SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ') AS "total_amount_withdrawn", COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) FILTER (WHERE "t".operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL) AS "external_counterparties" FROM "trans" AS "t" GROUP BY "t".account_id), "loan_counts" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_loans" FROM "loan" AS "l" GROUP BY "l".account_id), "account_report" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "dis".a2 AS "district_name", "dis".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("tt".total_amount_received, 0) AS "total_amount_received", COALESCE("tt".total_amount_withdrawn, 0) AS "total_amount_withdrawn", COALESCE("lc".number_of_loans, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("tt".external_counterparties, 0) AS "external_counterparties" FROM "gold_accounts" AS "ga" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "ga".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "dis" ON "dis".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "transaction_totals" AS "tt" ON "tt".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN "loan_counts" AS "lc" ON "lc".account_id = "a".account_id) SELECT account_id, district_name, region, total_amount_received, total_amount_withdrawn, number_of_loans, external_counterparties, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY external_counterparties DESC) AS "rank" FROM "account_report" ORDER BY external_counterparties DESC, account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "ea" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opened_date", "c".gender, "c".birth_date FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Tabor' AND "a".date <= DATE '1996-12-31'), "cc" AS (SELECT "dp".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "cards_held" FROM "disp" AS "dp" INNER JOIN "card" AS "cd" ON "cd".disp_id = "dp".disp_id WHERE "dp".type = 'OWNER' AND "cd".issued <= DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY "dp".account_id), "ls" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loans_held", BOOL_OR(status = 'B') AS "has_default", BOOL_OR(status IN ('C', 'D')) AS "has_repaying" FROM "loan" WHERE date <= DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY account_id), "act" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "money_in", SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "money_out", MAX(balance) AS "peak_balance" FROM "trans" WHERE date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY account_id), "p" AS (SELECT "ea".account_id, "ea".opened_date, "ea".gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '1996-12-31', "ea".birth_date))::INTEGER AS "owner_age", COALESCE("cc".cards_held, 0) AS "cards_held", COALESCE("ls".loans_held, 0) AS "loans_held", CASE WHEN "ls".account_id IS NULL THEN 'no loan' WHEN "ls".has_default THEN 'defaulted' WHEN "ls".has_repaying THEN 'repaying' ELSE 'paid off' END AS "loan_standing", COALESCE("act".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("act".money_in, 0) AS "money_in", COALESCE("act".money_out, 0) AS "money_out", COALESCE("act".peak_balance, 0) AS "peak_balance" FROM "ea" LEFT JOIN "cc" ON "cc".account_id = "ea".account_id LEFT JOIN "ls" ON "ls".account_id = "ea".account_id LEFT JOIN "act" ON "act".account_id = "ea".account_id) SELECT account_id, opened_date, gender, owner_age, cards_held, loans_held, loan_standing, transaction_count, money_in, money_out, peak_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC) AS "peak_balance_rank" FROM "p" ORDER BY peak_balance_rank ASC, account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "d".client_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "a".account_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "d".disp_id AND "c".type = 'classic'), "district_clients" AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS "client_count" FROM "qualifying_accounts" GROUP BY district_id), "district_payments" AS (SELECT "qa".district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) AS "external_account_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "qualifying_accounts" AS "qa" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "qa".account_id AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' WHERE "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "qa".district_id) SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", COALESCE("dc".client_count, 0) AS "client_count", COALESCE("dp".external_account_count, 0) AS "external_account_count", COALESCE("dp".total_amount, 0) AS "total_amount" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "district_clients" AS "dc" ON "dc".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "district_payments" AS "dp" ON "dp".district_id = "d".district_id ORDER BY total_amount DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1930-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "cohorts".cohort, ROUND(AVG("cohorts".salary)) AS "average_salary" FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' THEN 'young cohort' WHEN "c".birth_date <= DATE '1919-12-31' THEN 'old cohort' END AS "cohort", "d".a11 AS "salary" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' OR "c".birth_date <= DATE '1919-12-31') AS "cohorts" GROUP BY "cohorts".cohort ORDER BY CASE "cohorts".cohort WHEN 'young cohort' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND((("r853".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC - "r854".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC) / "r854".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC) * 100, 2) AS "percentage_higher" FROM "results" AS "r853" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r854" ON "r853".driverid = "r854".driverid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r853".driverid WHERE "d".forename = 'Paul' AND "d".surname = 'di Resta' AND "r853".raceid = 853 AND "r854".raceid = 854 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "r".positionorder <> 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_not_victories" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "d".forename = 'Lewis' AND "d".surname = 'Hamilton' AND "ra".year >= 2010 LIMIT 501

WITH "win_counts" AS (SELECT "r".driverid, COUNT(*) AS "wins" FROM "results" AS "r" WHERE "r".position = 1 GROUP BY "r".driverid), "top_driver" AS (SELECT driverid FROM "win_counts" ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality, MAX("ds".points) AS "highest_recorded_driver_standings_points" FROM "top_driver" AS "t" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "t".driverid INNER JOIN "driverstandings" AS "ds" ON "ds".driverid = "t".driverid GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "r".laps = "winner".laps) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "results" AS "winner" ON "winner".raceid = "r".raceid AND "winner".positionorder = 1 WHERE "d".nationality = 'Japanese' AND "ra".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009 LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, ROUND(AVG("res".milliseconds::NUMERIC) / 1000, 2) AS "mean_winner_elapsed_time_seconds" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year < 1975 AND "res".positionorder = 1 AND "res".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "d".dob < DATE '1985-01-01' AND "res".laps > 50) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "ra".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".name, "c".nationality, SUM("cr".points) AS "score" FROM "constructorresults" AS "cr" INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "c".constructorid = "cr".constructorid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "cr".raceid WHERE "r".name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".nationality ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_name" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".year = 2008 AND "c".name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "q".q3::INTERVAL ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "full_name" FROM "laptimes" AS "l" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "l".driverid WHERE "l".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname ORDER BY MIN("l".milliseconds) ASC LIMIT 20

SELECT "c".name, (MIN("l".milliseconds) / 60000)::TEXT || ':' || CASE WHEN (MIN("l".milliseconds) % 60000) / 1000 < 10 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || ((MIN("l".milliseconds) % 60000) / 1000)::TEXT || '.' || CASE WHEN MIN("l".milliseconds) % 1000 < 10 THEN '00' WHEN MIN("l".milliseconds) % 1000 < 100 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || (MIN("l".milliseconds) % 1000)::TEXT AS "fastest_lap_time" FROM "circuits" AS "c" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".circuitid = "c".circuitid INNER JOIN "laptimes" AS "l" ON "l".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "c".country = 'Italy' GROUP BY "c".circuitid, "c".name ORDER BY "c".name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(stop_count), 2) AS "average_pit_stops_per_race" FROM (SELECT "r".raceid, COUNT("p".stop) AS "stop_count" FROM "races" AS "r" LEFT JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "races" AS "r2000" WHERE "r2000".year = 2000 AND "r2000".name = "r".name) GROUP BY "r".raceid) AS "race_pit_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".url, "d".dob, COUNT("q".q3) AS "q3_times" FROM "drivers" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL WHERE "d".nationality = 'German' AND "d".dob >= DATE '1971-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1986-01-01' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".url, "d".dob ORDER BY q3_times DESC, "d".dob ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "q" AS (SELECT "d".driverref, "d".nationality, "d".dob, "qu".q1, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "qu".q1 DESC NULLS LAST) AS "rnk" FROM "qualifying" AS "qu" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "qu".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "qu".driverid WHERE "ra".year = 1995 AND "ra".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "qu".q1 IS NOT NULL) SELECT driverref, nationality, dob, q1 FROM "q" WHERE rnk = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 = (SELECT MAX("q2".q1) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 1995 AND "r2".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q2".q1 IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q1 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q1) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 1995 AND "r2".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q2".q1 IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "qualifying" AS "q1" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q1".raceid INNER JOIN "qualifying" AS "q2" ON "q2".raceid = "q1".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d1" ON "d1".driverid = "q1".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2010 AND "d1".forename = 'Lucas' AND "d1".surname = 'di Grassi' AND "q1".position < "q2".position LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "r".circuitid = "c".circuitid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 <> '' AND "q".q2 = (SELECT MIN("q2row".q2) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2row" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "q2row".raceid = "r2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2row".q2 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "runner_up_count" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "res".position = 2 GROUP BY "d".forename HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) >= 2 ORDER BY runner_up_count DESC, "d".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, "d".nationality, "d".dob FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 <> '' AND "q".q3 = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 = (SELECT MIN(q2) FROM "qualifying" AS "qx" INNER JOIN "races" AS "rx" ON "rx".raceid = "qx".raceid WHERE "rx".year = 2017 AND "rx".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "qx".q2 IS NOT NULL AND q2 > (SELECT MIN(q2) FROM "qualifying" AS "qy" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ry" ON "ry".raceid = "qy".raceid WHERE "ry".year = 2017 AND "ry".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "qy".q2 IS NOT NULL)) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 < '1:40.000' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".name, "c".location, "c".country, "r".year, "p".duration FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "p".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "p".milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM "pitstops") LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("q".q3_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_q3_lap_times" FROM "drivers" AS "d" LEFT JOIN (SELECT driverid, COUNT(q3) AS "q3_count" FROM "qualifying" WHERE q3 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY driverid) AS "q" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1992-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "d".code IS NULL AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 <> 'N' AND "d".forename IN (SELECT forename FROM "drivers" GROUP BY forename HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AND split_part("q".q1, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60 + split_part(split_part("q".q1, ':', 2), '.', 1)::INTEGER + CASE WHEN POSITION('.' IN "q".q1) > 0 THEN ('0.' || split_part("q".q1, '.', 2))::NUMERIC ELSE 0 END > 120 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, SUM("res".points) AS "total_points" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT raceid, driverid FROM "laptimes") AS "lt" ON "lt".driverid = "res".driverid AND "lt".raceid = "res".raceid WHERE "d".forename = 'Robert' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".driverref LIMIT 501

SELECT "races".date, "drivers".forename, "drivers".surname, "results".fastestlaptime FROM "races" INNER JOIN "results" ON "results".raceid = "races".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" ON "drivers".driverid = "results".driverid WHERE "races".year >= 1990 AND "races".name = 'French Grand Prix' ORDER BY "races".date ASC, "drivers".surname ASC, "drivers".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q3 AS "fastest_q3_lap_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "d2".driverid = "q2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

WITH "british" AS (SELECT driverid, forename, surname FROM "drivers" WHERE nationality = 'British' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dob) > 1980), "q3_times" AS (SELECT "b".forename || ' ' || "b".surname AS "full_name", "r".name AS "race_name", "r".year AS "race_year", "q".q3 AS "q3_time", "q".q3::INTERVAL AS "q3_interval" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "british" AS "b" ON "b".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '') SELECT full_name, race_name, race_year, q3_time FROM "q3_times" WHERE q3_interval = (SELECT MIN(q3_interval) FROM "q3_times") LIMIT 501

WITH "driver_race_fastest" AS (SELECT raceid, driverid, MIN(milliseconds) AS "fastest_ms" FROM "laptimes" GROUP BY raceid, driverid), "ranked" AS (SELECT raceid, driverid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY fastest_ms ASC) AS "lap_rank" FROM "driver_race_fastest") SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "count" FROM "ranked" AS "r" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid WHERE "r".lap_rank = 2 AND "d".dob >= DATE '1976-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "q2".raceid = "r2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

WITH "constructor_season_points" AS (SELECT "cs".constructorid, "r".year, MAX("cs".points) AS "season_points" FROM "constructorstandings" AS "cs" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "cs".raceid GROUP BY "cs".constructorid, "r".year), "italian_career_points" AS (SELECT "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url, COALESCE(SUM("csp".season_points), 0) AS "career_points" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "constructor_season_points" AS "csp" ON "csp".constructorid = "c".constructorid WHERE "c".nationality = 'Italian' GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url), "ranked" AS (SELECT name, career_points, url, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY career_points DESC) AS "rank" FROM "italian_career_points") SELECT name, career_points, url FROM "ranked" WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY rank ASC, name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "drivers_with_a_race_win" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".forename IN ('Peter', 'John') AND "r".position = 1 GROUP BY "d".forename ORDER BY CASE "d".forename WHEN 'Peter' THEN 1 WHEN 'John' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "q".q3 <> '' AND split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60000 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC * 1000 = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q3, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60000 + split_part("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC * 1000) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "r".rank = 1 THEN "c".constructorid END) AS "constructor_count" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".constructorid = "c".constructorid GROUP BY "c".nationality ORDER BY "c".nationality ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year AS "season_year", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "races" AS "pr" ON "pr".raceid = "p".raceid WHERE "pr".year = "r".year AND "pr".raceid IN (SELECT "ds".raceid FROM "driverstandings" AS "ds" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "ds".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Australian' AND "ds".position BETWEEN 1 AND 19)) AS "total_pit_stops" FROM "races" AS "r" WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013 GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 <> '' AND (split_part("q".q1, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60 + split_part("q".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) > 120 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_full_name", "p".duration AS "pit_stop_time", "r".name AS "race_name", "c".name AS "circuit_name", "c".location AS "circuit_location" FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "p".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "r".circuitid = "c".circuitid WHERE "r".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r".date < DATE '2016-10-01' AND "p".milliseconds = (SELECT MIN("p2".milliseconds) FROM "pitstops" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "p2".raceid = "r2".raceid WHERE "r2".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r2".date < DATE '2016-10-01') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "full_name", "d".nationality, "first_win".name AS "first_race_won", "first_win".date AS "first_win_date", COUNT(*) AS "races_started" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "win" ON "win".driverid = "d".driverid AND "win".position = 1 INNER JOIN "races" AS "rw" ON "rw".raceid = "win".raceid AND "rw".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 INNER JOIN (SELECT driverid, name, date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY driverid ORDER BY date ASC, name ASC) AS "rn" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".position = 1 AND "ra".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017) AS "first_win" ON "first_win".driverid = "d".driverid AND "first_win".rn = 1 INNER JOIN "results" AS "started" ON "started".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "rs" ON "rs".raceid = "started".raceid AND "rs".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 WHERE "d".dob IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality, "d".dob, "first_win".name, "first_win".date ORDER BY "d".dob ASC, "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".raceid) FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Accident' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "c".name FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "c".constructorid = "q".constructorid WHERE "ra".year = 2017 AND "ra".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "q".q2 ASC, "q".position ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT "d".surname, "r".name FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 = (SELECT MIN(q2) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "q2".raceid = "r2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "q2".q2 IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".position = 1 AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".code, "q".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "q2".raceid = "r2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "r".time, (SELECT "res".time FROM "results" AS "res" WHERE "res".raceid = "r".raceid AND "res".positionorder = 2 LIMIT 1) AS "runner_up_time_gap" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 ORDER BY "r".time ASC, "r".year DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".code FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "d".code ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "races".year, "drivers".forename, "drivers".surname, "results".time FROM "races" INNER JOIN "results" ON "results".raceid = "races".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" ON "drivers".driverid = "results".driverid WHERE "races".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "races".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017 AND "races".time <= '17:00:00' AND "results".position = 1 ORDER BY "races".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number AS "permanent_career_race_number", "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 <> '' AND (split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) < 98 LIMIT 501

WITH "race_times" AS (SELECT "c".circuitref, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM "r".time::TIME) * 3600 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM "r".time::TIME) * 60 + EXTRACT(SECOND FROM "r".time::TIME) AS "start_seconds" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".time IS NOT NULL), "extrema" AS (SELECT MIN(start_seconds) AS "earliest_seconds", MAX(start_seconds) AS "latest_seconds" FROM "race_times") SELECT (SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "rt".circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY "rt".circuitref ASC) FROM "race_times" AS "rt" WHERE "rt".start_seconds = "e".earliest_seconds) AS "earliest_circuitrefs", (SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "rt".circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY "rt".circuitref ASC) FROM "race_times" AS "rt" WHERE "rt".start_seconds = "e".latest_seconds) AS "latest_circuitrefs", ("e".latest_seconds - "e".earliest_seconds)::BIGINT AS "gap_seconds" FROM "extrema" AS "e" LIMIT 501

WITH "career_highs" AS (SELECT "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".dob, MAX(NULLIF("r".fastestlapspeed, '')::NUMERIC) AS "career_high_speed" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1991-01-01' AND "r".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND "r".fastestlapspeed <> '' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".dob) SELECT forename, surname FROM "career_highs" ORDER BY career_high_speed DESC, dob ASC, surname ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 IS NULL ORDER BY "q".q1 DESC, "d".driverid ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "results".driverid) FROM "results" INNER JOIN "races" ON "results".raceid = "races".raceid INNER JOIN "status" ON "results".statusid = "status".statusid WHERE "races".year = 1962 AND "races".name = 'British Grand Prix' AND "status".status = 'Withdrew' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "results".position IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" INNER JOIN "races" ON "results".raceid = "races".raceid WHERE "races".year = 1957 AND "races".name = 'British Grand Prix' AND "results".positionorder > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_expense)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "mean_total_expense_per_event" FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("e".cost) AS "event_expense" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Elijah' AND "m".last_name = 'Allen' AND "e".expense_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".expense_date < '2019-11-01' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "event_totals" LIMIT 501

SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01') - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2021-01-01') AS "total_spent_2019_minus_2020" LIMIT 501
SELECT notes FROM "income" WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14' LIMIT 501

SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN "e".event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN "b".amount END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN "e".event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN "b".amount END), 0) AS "ratio" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "b".category = 'Advertisement' AND "e".event_name IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting') LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, SUM("b".spent) / NULLIF(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "spending_to_budget_ratio" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name HAVING SUM("b".spent) / NULLIF(SUM("b".amount), 0) = (SELECT MAX(event_ratio) FROM (SELECT SUM("b2".spent) / NULLIF(SUM("b2".amount), 0) AS "event_ratio" FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b2" ON "b2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id WHERE "e2".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e2".event_id) AS "ratios") LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) > 7 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, "m".phone FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "e".cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM "expense") LIMIT 501

WITH "event_counts" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, "e".event_name, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "head_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name), "summary" AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN event_name = 'Women''s Soccer' THEN head_count END) AS "womens_soccer_head_count", ROUND(AVG(head_count)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "fall_2019_average" FROM "event_counts") SELECT womens_soccer_head_count, fall_2019_average, CASE WHEN womens_soccer_head_count > fall_2019_average THEN 'more' WHEN womens_soccer_head_count < fall_2019_average THEN 'fewer' ELSE 'equal' END AS "verdict" FROM "summary" LIMIT 501

WITH "college_departments" AS (SELECT DISTINCT department FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'), "major_member_counts" AS (SELECT "m".department, "m".major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "mem".member_id) AS "member_count" FROM "major" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "mem" ON "mem".link_to_major = "m".major_id WHERE "m".department IN (SELECT department FROM "college_departments") GROUP BY "m".department, "m".major_name) SELECT department AS "department_name", STRING_AGG(major_name, ', ' ORDER BY major_name ASC) AS "majors_offered", STRING_AGG(major_name, ', ' ORDER BY major_name ASC) FILTER (WHERE member_count > 0) AS "majors_held_by_members", ROUND(AVG(member_count)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_members_per_major" FROM "major_member_counts" GROUP BY department ORDER BY department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e"."type" AS "event_type", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "members_attended", COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "total_budgeted_dollars" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "e"."type" ORDER BY "e"."type" ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "ma".department, COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues" FROM "major" AS "ma" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".link_to_major = "ma".major_id AND "m".position = 'Member' LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".link_to_member FROM "attendance" AS "a") AS "attended" ON "attended".link_to_member = "m".member_id LEFT JOIN "income" AS "i" ON "i".link_to_member = "m".member_id AND "i".source = 'Dues' WHERE "ma".college = 'College of Engineering' GROUP BY "ma".department ORDER BY "ma".department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, ROUND(SUM("b".amount - "b".spent)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_amount_left" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "e".cost > 50 GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name ORDER BY total_amount_left DESC, "m".last_name ASC, "m".first_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues_dollars" FROM "income" AS "i" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "i".link_to_member INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "a".link_to_event WHERE "e".event_name = 'Football game' AND "i".source = 'Dues' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "major" AS "m" WHERE "m".college = (SELECT "tm".college FROM "member" AS "t" INNER JOIN "major" AS "tm" ON "tm".major_id = "t".link_to_major WHERE "t".first_name = 'Tyler' AND "t".last_name = 'Hewitt') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" AS "enrolled" WHERE "enrolled".link_to_major = "m".major_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendee_count), 2) AS "average_attendees_per_event" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "b".category ILIKE 'advertisement' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_attendance" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendees" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".type = 'Budget' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" AS "a" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "a".link_to_event INNER JOIN "member" AS "mem" ON "mem".member_id = "a".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "m" ON "m".major_id = "mem".link_to_major WHERE "e".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "m".major_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) = (SELECT MAX(major_attendee_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a2".link_to_member) AS "major_attendee_count" FROM "attendance" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e2" ON "e2".event_id = "a2".link_to_event INNER JOIN "member" AS "mem2" ON "mem2".member_id = "a2".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "m2" ON "m2".major_id = "mem2".link_to_major WHERE "e2".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "m2".major_name) AS "attendee_counts") ORDER BY "m".major_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" AS "m" WHERE "m"."link_to_major" = "ma"."major_id")) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "major" AS "ma" LIMIT 501

WITH "member_event_counts" AS (SELECT "m".member_id, "m".position, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) AS "events_attended" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".position) SELECT group_name, ROUND(AVG(events_attended)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_events_attended" FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN 'officer' ELSE 'other student' END AS "group_name", events_attended FROM "member_event_counts") AS "counts" GROUP BY group_name ORDER BY CASE group_name WHEN 'officer' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "over_budget_events" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "b".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "ev" ON "ev".event_id = "b".link_to_event WHERE "b".amount - "b".spent < 0), "matched" AS (SELECT "e".expense_description FROM "over_budget_events" AS "obe" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "obe".link_to_event INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id), "kind_sets" AS (SELECT CASE WHEN expense_description ILIKE '%water%' THEN 'Water' END AS "kind" FROM "matched" UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN expense_description ILIKE '%cookies%' THEN 'Cookies' END FROM "matched" UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN expense_description ILIKE '%chips%' THEN 'Chips' END FROM "matched" UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN expense_description ILIKE '%veggie tray%' THEN 'Veggie tray' END FROM "matched" UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN expense_description ILIKE '%supplies%' THEN 'Supplies' END FROM "matched" UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN expense_description ILIKE '%pizza%' THEN 'Pizza' END FROM "matched" UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN expense_description ILIKE '%posters%' THEN 'Posters' END FROM "matched" UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN expense_description ILIKE '%post cards%' THEN 'Post Cards' END FROM "matched"), "kind_sets2" AS (SELECT kind FROM "kind_sets" UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN expense_description ILIKE '%donuts%' THEN 'Donuts' END FROM "matched" UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN expense_description ILIKE '%muffins%' THEN 'Muffins' END FROM "matched" UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN expense_description ILIKE '%club shirts%' THEN 'Club shirts' END FROM "matched" UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN expense_description ILIKE '%parking%' THEN 'Parking' END FROM "matched" UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN expense_description ILIKE '%alumni glass%' THEN 'Alumni Glass' END FROM "matched" UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN expense_description ILIKE '%travel mug%' THEN 'Travel Mug' END FROM "matched") SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT kind) AS "count" FROM "kind_sets2" WHERE kind IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "ev".event_name, ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM("ex".cost) FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "ex" ON "ex".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".link_to_event = "ev".event_id AND "ex".expense_description ILIKE '%water%'), 0)::NUMERIC / COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member), 2) AS "amount_spent_per_attendee" FROM "event" AS "ev" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "ev".event_id GROUP BY "ev".event_id, "ev".event_name LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "m".college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences') AS "members_majoring_in_college", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "m".college <> 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' OR "m".college IS NULL) AS "members_not_majoring_in_college" FROM "member" AS "u" LEFT JOIN "major" AS "m" ON "u".link_to_major = "m".major_id LIMIT 501

WITH "chip_events" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "e".event_id, "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%'), "event_max" AS (SELECT "ce".event_id, "ce".event_name, MAX("b".amount) AS "largest_line" FROM "chip_events" AS "ce" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "ce".event_id GROUP BY "ce".event_id, "ce".event_name) SELECT event_name FROM "event_max" WHERE largest_line = (SELECT MAX(largest_line) FROM "event_max") LIMIT 501

SELECT MAX("e".expense_date) AS "expense_date", SUM("e".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".position = 'Vice President' AND "e".expense_date = (SELECT MAX("e2".expense_date) FROM "expense" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m2" ON "e2".link_to_member = "m2".member_id WHERE "m2".position = 'Vice President') LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".location = 'MU 215' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "college_counts" AS (SELECT "ma".college, COUNT(DISTINCT "ma".major_id) AS "number_of_majors" FROM "member" AS "me" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma" ON "me".link_to_major = "ma".major_id GROUP BY "ma".college), "ranked" AS (SELECT college, number_of_majors, MAX(number_of_majors) OVER () AS "max_count" FROM "college_counts") SELECT college, number_of_majors FROM "ranked" WHERE number_of_majors = max_count ORDER BY college ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "x".expense_description) AS "different_things_bought" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".amount > 40 GROUP BY "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("b".amount) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_budget FROM "expense" WHERE expense_description = 'Pizza') AS "p" ON "p".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-10-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT TO_CHAR(AVG(event_spent), 'FM999999999999990.00') AS "average_spent_per_event" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) AS "event_spent" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "per_event" LIMIT 501

WITH "event_budget" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, "e".event_name, SUM("b".amount) AS "total_budget", SUM("b".spent) AS "total_spending" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name), "eligible" AS (SELECT * FROM "event_budget" WHERE total_spending <= total_budget), "purchase_counts" AS (SELECT "eb".event_id, COUNT("x".expense_id) AS "purchase_count" FROM "eligible" AS "eb" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "eb".event_id LEFT JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id GROUP BY "eb".event_id) SELECT "eb".event_name FROM "eligible" AS "eb" INNER JOIN "purchase_counts" AS "pc" ON "pc".event_id = "eb".event_id ORDER BY "pc".purchase_count DESC, "eb".event_id ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "type_counts" AS (SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e".type) SELECT type, member_count FROM "type_counts" WHERE member_count = (SELECT MAX(member_count) FROM "type_counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT "x".expense_description, COUNT(*) AS "record_count" FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".category = 'Food' GROUP BY "x".expense_description ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "x".expense_description ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "b".category, "e".expense_description AS "item_name", SUM("e".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN "event" AS "ev" ON "b".link_to_event = "ev".event_id WHERE "ev".event_name = 'October Meeting' AND "e".approved = 'true' GROUP BY "b".category, "e".expense_description ORDER BY "b".category ASC, item_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".event_date, COALESCE("b".total_amount_budgeted, 0) AS "total_amount_budgeted", COALESCE("a".attendee_count, 0) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS "total_amount_budgeted" FROM "budget" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC, "e".event_date ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "expense".expense_description AS "item_name", COUNT(*) AS "purchase_count" FROM "expense" INNER JOIN "member" ON "expense".link_to_member = "member".member_id WHERE "member".first_name = 'Sacha' AND "member".last_name = 'Harrison' GROUP BY "expense".expense_description ORDER BY "expense".expense_description ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "major".major_name) FROM "member" INNER JOIN "major" ON "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id WHERE "major".department = 'Political Science Department' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) AS "hero_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "c".colour ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "s".id = "hp".hero_id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "hp".power_id = "sp".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "sp".power_name = 'Super Strength' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral') / COUNT(*), 2) AS "neutral_percentage", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "neutral_marvel_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".publisher_name, COUNT("s".id) AS "superhero_count" FROM "publisher" AS "p" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics') GROUP BY "p".publisher_name ORDER BY COUNT("s".id) DESC LIMIT 501
