SELECT DISTINCT "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Strength') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "p".publisher_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "eye" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "eye".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "hair" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "hair".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "skin" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "skin".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "eye".colour IS NOT NULL AND "hair".colour IS NOT NULL AND "skin".colour IS NOT NULL AND "eye".colour = "hair".colour AND "hair".colour = "skin".colour LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "skin_colour".colour = 'Blue') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" INNER JOIN "gender" ON "superhero".gender_id = "gender".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "skin_colour" ON "superhero".skin_colour_id = "skin_colour".id WHERE "gender".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "counts".dc_count > "counts".marvel_count THEN 'DC Comics' WHEN "counts".marvel_count > "counts".dc_count THEN 'Marvel Comics' ELSE 'Tie' END AS "publisher", ABS("counts".dc_count - "counts".marvel_count) AS "difference" FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') AS "dc_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "marvel_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics')) AS "counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".height_cm) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "hp".power_id NOT IN (SELECT "dhp".power_id FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dp" ON "dp".id = "dc".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "dhp" ON "dhp".hero_id = "dc".id WHERE "dp".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "count" FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "hp".hero_id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "ha".attribute_value > 0 AND "hp".power_id NOT IN (SELECT "hp2".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp2" WHERE "hp2".hero_id NOT IN (SELECT "ha2".hero_id FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "ha2".attribute_value > 0)) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "c".colour ILIKE 'green' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "a".alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad') LIMIT 501

SELECT "sp".power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "pub" ON "s".publisher_id = "pub".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "hp".power_id = "sp".id WHERE "pub".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '' GROUP BY "sp".id, "sp".power_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) = (SELECT MAX(power_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s2".id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "pub2" ON "s2".publisher_id = "pub2".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp2" ON "hp2".hero_id = "s2".id WHERE "pub2".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s2".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s2".full_name <> '' GROUP BY "hp2".power_id) AS "counts") ORDER BY "sp".power_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT "ha_ab".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "ab" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha_ab" ON "ha_ab".hero_id = "ab".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a_ab" ON "a_ab".id = "ha_ab".attribute_id WHERE "ab".superhero_name = 'Abomination' AND "a_ab".attribute_name = 'Intelligence') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg))::INTEGER AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT "ha_hulk".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha_hulk" ON "ha_hulk".hero_id = "h".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a_hulk" ON "a_hulk".id = "ha_hulk".attribute_id WHERE "h".superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND "a_hulk".attribute_name = 'Strength') AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("dc".weight_kg)) FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dc_pub" ON "dc".publisher_id = "dc_pub".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "dc_eye" ON "dc".eye_colour_id = "dc_eye".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "marvel_eye".colour FROM "superhero" AS "marvel" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "marvel_pub" ON "marvel".publisher_id = "marvel_pub".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "marvel_eye" ON "marvel".eye_colour_id = "marvel_eye".id WHERE "marvel_pub".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "shared_eye" ON "shared_eye".colour = "dc_eye".colour WHERE "dc_pub".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "dc".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".height_cm)::NUMERIC(10, 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "a" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".race_id = "a".race_id WHERE "a".superhero_name = 'A-Bomb' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".weight_kg) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".race_id IS NOT NULL AND "s".race_id IN (SELECT "s2".race_id FROM "superhero" AS "s2" WHERE "s2".race_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "s2".race_id HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "s2".gender_id = (SELECT "g".id FROM "gender" AS "g" WHERE "g".gender = 'Female')) = 0) LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s".publisher_id) AS "publisher_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" WHERE "s".height_cm > 200 AND "s".publisher_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "p".publisher_name <> 'DC Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg", COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "target_hero" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "blackwulf" ON "blackwulf"."superhero_name" = 'Blackwulf' WHERE "target_hero"."publisher_id" = "blackwulf"."publisher_id" AND "target_hero"."eye_colour_id" IS NOT NULL AND "target_hero"."eye_colour_id" IN (SELECT DISTINCT "other_hero"."eye_colour_id" FROM "superhero" AS "other_hero" WHERE "other_hero"."publisher_id" IS NOT NULL AND "other_hero"."publisher_id" <> "blackwulf"."publisher_id" AND "other_hero"."eye_colour_id" IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".race, COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "target" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".publisher_id = "target".publisher_id INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE "target".full_name = 'Charles Chandler' AND "s".race_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "r".race HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(race_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "race_count" FROM "superhero" AS "target2" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s2" ON "s2".publisher_id = "target2".publisher_id INNER JOIN "race" AS "r2" ON "r2".id = "s2".race_id WHERE "target2".full_name = 'Charles Chandler' AND "s2".race_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "r2".race) AS "race_counts") ORDER BY "r".race ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg::NUMERIC), 2) FROM "superhero" INNER JOIN "gender" ON "superhero".gender_id = "gender".id WHERE "gender".gender = 'Female' AND weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("ha".attribute_value)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_intelligence_score" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "sp".power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch') LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("p".power_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_superpowers" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN (SELECT hero_id, COUNT(*) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" GROUP BY hero_id) AS "p" ON "p".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND POSITION(' ' IN BTRIM("s".full_name)) > 0 GROUP BY "g".gender ORDER BY "g".gender ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm) FILTER (WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL), 2) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg) FILTER (WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm) FILTER (WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL), 1) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg) FILTER (WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL), 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp3" ON "hp3".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "hp3".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man' AND "s".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "s".id = "hp".hero_id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "hp".power_id = "sp".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' AND "sp".power_name = 'Flight' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Male' AND "s".weight_kg < 70 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "r".race = 'Human' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "s".height_cm ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "lightest" AS (SELECT MIN(weight_kg) AS "min_weight" FROM "superhero" WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL), "power_counts" AS (SELECT "s".id, COUNT(DISTINCT "sp".power_name) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "s".weight_kg = (SELECT min_weight FROM "lightest") GROUP BY "s".id) SELECT MAX(power_count) FROM "power_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Speed' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Speed') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "eye_colour".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eye_colour" ON "superhero".eye_colour_id = "eye_colour".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair_colour" ON "superhero".hair_colour_id = "hair_colour".id WHERE "eye_colour".id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "brown_eyes".eye_colour_id FROM "superhero" AS "brown_eyes" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "brown_hair" ON "brown_eyes".hair_colour_id = "brown_hair".id WHERE "brown_hair".colour = 'Brown') AND ("hair_colour".colour <> 'Brown' OR "hair_colour".colour IS NULL) GROUP BY "eye_colour".colour ORDER BY count DESC, "eye_colour".colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_good" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND "s".full_name ILIKE '% %' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".alignment = 'Good' THEN "s".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_hp" ON "target_hp".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "target_hp".hero_id WHERE "s".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "eye_colour".colour = 'No Colour') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "eye_colour".colour ILIKE 'blue') AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "eye_colour" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "eye_colour".id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F'), 0) AS "male_to_female_ratio" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE ("p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0) OR ("p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".alb)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "average_alb" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".plt > 400 AND "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".tg >= 200 AND "l".date = DATE '2026-10-09' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1976-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".glu >= 180 AND "l"."T-CHO" < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hct >= 52 AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p".id, "p".birthday HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage_female" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday < DATE '1971-10-09' AND "l".date = DATE '2026-10-09' AND "l".pt >= 14 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".crp LIKE '%+%' AND "p".description IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') AND "e".id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p"."admission" IN ('+', '+(')) / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l") AS "tested" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "tested".id WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1930-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1941-01-01' LIMIT 501

WITH "strongest_rnp" AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::INTEGER END) AS "max_rnp" FROM "laboratory"), "candidates" AS (SELECT "l"."T-BIL", "l".date, "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" CROSS JOIN "strongest_rnp" AS "s" WHERE "l".rnp = "s".max_rnp::TEXT AND "l"."T-BIL" IS NOT NULL), "highest_bilirubin" AS (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") AS "max_bilirubin" FROM "candidates") SELECT "c"."T-BIL", "c".date, "c".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "candidates" AS "c" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "c".id CROSS JOIN "highest_bilirubin" AS "h" WHERE "c"."T-BIL" = "h".max_bilirubin LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS "count" FROM (SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1960-01-01' GROUP BY "p".id HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "e".thrombosis IS NOT NULL AND "e".thrombosis <> 0) > 0 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 10) = 0) AS "qualifying_patients" LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "l".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')), "titers" AS (SELECT "l".id, MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) AS "anti_rnp_titer" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "eligible" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' GROUP BY "l".id) SELECT id, anti_rnp_titer FROM "titers" WHERE anti_rnp_titer = (SELECT MAX(anti_rnp_titer) FROM "titers") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'MCTD' AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 5 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".lab_date_count, 0))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_laboratory_test_dates" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS "lab_date_count" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "l" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, "l".date, "l"."DNA-II", MAX("l"."DNA-II") OVER (PARTITION BY "p".id) AS "highest_level" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission = '+' AND "l"."DNA-II" IS NOT NULL) SELECT id, date, "DNA-II" FROM "eligible" WHERE "DNA-II" = highest_level ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 16 AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE hct <= 29 OR hct >= 52 GROUP BY id) AS "h" ON "h".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::INTEGER > 16 GROUP BY id) AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "normal".patient_id IS NOT NULL) AS "patients_with_normal_platelet", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "normal".patient_id IS NULL) AS "patients_never_with_normal_platelet" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id AS "patient_id" FROM "laboratory" WHERE plt > 100 AND plt < 400) AS "normal" ON "normal".patient_id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis IN ('RA, SJS', 'SJS, RA', 'MRA, SJS', 'SJS, MRA') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp - 8.5)::NUMERIC, 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l".tp > 8.5 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".rnp IN ('4', '15', '16', '64', '256')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "average_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) AS "women", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "p".id END) AS "men" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 32 LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)::INTEGER) AS "youngest_age" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp IN ('64', '256') AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT("l".id) AS "total_laboratory_tests", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NULL) AS "patients_with_no_laboratory_tests" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501
SELECT "e".symptoms FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".thrombosis = 1 AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".thrombosis = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e".first_exam_date - "p"."First Date")) AS "average_delay_days" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MIN("Examination Date") AS "first_exam_date" FROM "examination" GROUP BY id) AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' AND "p"."First Date" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND ("l"."U-PRO" = '300' OR "l"."U-PRO" = '>=300' OR "l"."U-PRO" = '>=1000') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "difference" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'RA' AND "l".un < 30 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_out_of_range_creatinine", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT * FROM (SELECT "l"."T-CHO" AS "highest T-CHO", "p".admission AS "admission status", "l".id AS "patient ID" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l"."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("l2"."T-CHO") FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".admission = '+') UNION ALL SELECT "l"."T-CHO" AS "highest T-CHO", "p".admission AS "admission status", "l".id AS "patient ID" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l"."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("l2"."T-CHO") FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".admission = '-')) AS "u" ORDER BY CASE WHEN "admission status" = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "patient_levels" AS (SELECT "p".id, MAX(CASE "l".rnp WHEN '0' THEN 0 WHEN '1' THEN 1 WHEN '4' THEN 4 WHEN '15' THEN 15 WHEN '16' THEN 16 WHEN '64' THEN 64 WHEN '256' THEN 256 END) AS "highest_titer" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') GROUP BY "p".id), "top_titer" AS (SELECT MAX(highest_titer) AS "value" FROM "patient_levels") SELECT "pl".id, CAST("pl".highest_titer AS TEXT) AS "anti-RNP level" FROM "patient_levels" AS "pl" CROSS JOIN "top_titer" AS "tt" WHERE "pl".highest_titer = "tt".value ORDER BY "pl".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("hct") FROM "laboratory" WHERE "date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "hct" IS NOT NULL AND ("U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') OR "U-PRO" LIKE '+%' OR "U-PRO" = '4') LIMIT 501

SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "l".id) AND "l".date > DATE '1997-01-01' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l3" WHERE "l3".id = "l".id AND "l3".sc170 IS NOT NULL AND "l3".date > "l".date) GROUP BY "l".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM (SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" GROUP BY "l".id HAVING BOOL_OR("l".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "l".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')) AND BOOL_OR("l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0'))) AS "qualifying_patients" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l"."DNA-II" < 8 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission <> '-' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(rnp::INTEGER) FROM "laboratory" WHERE cre < 1.5 AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "p".sex WHEN 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hgb < 7.0 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT id, date, rnp, CASE WHEN rnp = 'negative' THEN NULL ELSE rnp::INTEGER END AS "rnp_value" FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60), "highest" AS (SELECT MAX(rnp_value) AS "max_rnp" FROM "eligible") SELECT "p".id, "e".date, "e".rnp FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id CROSS JOIN "highest" AS "h" WHERE "e".rnp_value = "h".max_rnp LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND ("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450 OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient_group", COUNT(*) AS "normal_ldh_measurements" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".ldh < 500 GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patients_with_any_laboratory_result", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0 THEN "l".id END) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "anemia" ON "anemia".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "anemia".hgb < 10 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex), "patient_max" AS (SELECT "e".id, "e".sex, MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) AS "highest" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' GROUP BY "e".id, "e".sex), "overall_max" AS (SELECT MAX(highest) AS "highest" FROM "patient_max") SELECT "pm".id, "pm".sex, "pm".highest AS "rnp" FROM "patient_max" AS "pm" CROSS JOIN "overall_max" AS "om" WHERE "pm".highest = "om".highest ORDER BY "pm".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "first_labs" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l".got, "l".rnp FROM "laboratory" AS "l" ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date ASC) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "first_labs" WHERE got < 60 AND rnp IN ('15', '16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "latest".date, "latest"."U-PRO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, date, "U-PRO", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL) AS "latest" ON "latest".id = "p".id WHERE "latest".rn = 1 LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".cpk < 250 AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 4 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp NOT IN ('0', 'negative') AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_patients" AS (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id HAVING bool_or(rnp IN ('16', '64', '256'))), "patient_max_gpt" AS (SELECT "l".id, MAX("l".gpt) AS "highest_normal_gpt" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "qualifying_patients" AS "q" ON "q".id = "l".id WHERE "l".gpt < 60 GROUP BY "l".id) SELECT "p".birthday FROM "patient_max_gpt" AS "m" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "m".id ORDER BY "m".highest_normal_gpt DESC, "m".id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".pt < 14 AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 16 LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE("l"."date", "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "age_in_completed_years", "p".diagnosis FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".dna DESC, "l"."date" ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 AND "p".diagnosis ~ '(^|[,[:space:]])SLE($|[,[:space:]])' ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_result_at_least_4", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".id IS NULL OR "l".rnp NOT IN ('4', '15', '16', '64', '256') OR "l".rnp IS NULL THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_no_such_result" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".igg >= 2000 AND "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "p".id) LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".diagnosis, MAX("l".dna) AS "highest_anti_dna_result" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p".id, "p".diagnosis HAVING MAX("l".dna::NUMERIC) = (SELECT MAX("l2".dna::NUMERIC) FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l2".dna IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_dates" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_visits" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "latest_dates" AS "d" ON "l".id = "d".id AND "l".date = "d".latest_date), "patient_counts" AS (SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "latest_visits" AS "v" ON "p".id = "v".id WHERE "v".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "v".rnp::INTEGER >= 32 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex) SELECT COALESCE(MAX(patient_count) FILTER (WHERE sex = 'F'), 0)::BIGINT - COALESCE(MAX(patient_count) FILTER (WHERE sex = 'M'), 0)::BIGINT AS "difference" FROM "patient_counts" LIMIT 501

WITH "latest" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l".rnp, "l".cpk FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date DESC) SELECT COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS "count" FROM "latest" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::INTEGER > 64 AND cpk < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, bool_or(ldh >= 500) AS "has_ldh", bool_or("U-PRO" IN ('100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+2(100)', '+1(30)')) AS "has_protein" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "qualifying" ON "qualifying".id = "p".id WHERE "qualifying".has_ldh AND "qualifying".has_protein ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms, "p".diagnosis FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "e".symptoms <> '' ORDER BY "p".birthday ASC, "p".id ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') AND "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' ORDER BY ("p"."First Date" - "p".birthday) DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE 'Psoriatic arthritis' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 'male' WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 'female' END AS "sex", COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 'Hospital admitted' WHEN '-' THEN 'Outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rbc < 3.5 AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM"::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SJS%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SJS susp%' AND "e"."aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis LIKE '%SjS%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT LIKE '%SjS susp%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "sm" ON "sm".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "protein" ON "protein".id = "p".id WHERE "sm".sm IN ('negative', '0') AND "e".thrombosis = 0 AND "protein"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "abnormal" ON "abnormal".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "positive" ON "positive".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND ("abnormal".rbc <= 3.5 OR "abnormal".rbc >= 6.0) AND "positive".rnp IN ('1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)))::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('64', '256')) AS "qualifying_patients" ON "qualifying_patients".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday) < INTERVAL '70 years' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".wbc > 3.5 AND "l".wbc < 9.0 AND ("l".fg <= 150 OR "l".fg >= 450) AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::INTEGER > 15 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M')), 0), 1) AS "women_pct" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday > "l".date - INTERVAL '50 years' AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'o') AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecules_with_single_bond" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS "average_single_bonds_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "a".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_bond_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "a2".molecule_id = "m2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "distinct_iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "distinct_sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f') THEN "m".molecule_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id), 0), 2) AS "percentage_without_fluorine" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT (SELECT "b".bond_type FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS "bond_type", CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR010' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '#') AND "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT "ap".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "ap" WHERE "ap".element IN ('p', 'br')) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "percentage_chlorine_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "hydrogen_atom_fraction", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

WITH "molecule_bond_summary" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label, COUNT("b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT("b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') AS "single_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label), "grouped" AS (SELECT CASE WHEN bond_count = single_bond_count THEN 'all single bonds' ELSE 'not all single bonds' END AS "bond_group", label FROM "molecule_bond_summary") SELECT bond_group, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '+') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '-') AS "carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic" FROM "grouped" GROUP BY bond_group ORDER BY CASE WHEN bond_group = 'all single bonds' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' AND "b".bond_type = '=' AND "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

WITH "plus_atoms" AS (SELECT "a".atom_id, "a".molecule_id, "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+'), "bonded_atom_ids" AS (SELECT atom_id AS "id" FROM "connected" UNION ALL SELECT atom_id2 AS "id" FROM "connected"), "bonded_element_counts" AS (SELECT "p".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".atom_id) AS "bonded_count" FROM "plus_atoms" AS "p" INNER JOIN "bonded_atom_ids" AS "b" ON "b".id = "p".atom_id GROUP BY "p".element), "most_common" AS (SELECT element, bonded_count FROM "bonded_element_counts" WHERE bonded_count = (SELECT MAX(bonded_count) FROM "bonded_element_counts")), "total_plus_atoms" AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_count" FROM "plus_atoms") SELECT "mc".element, ROUND(100.0 * "mc".bonded_count / "t".total_count, 2) AS "percentage" FROM "most_common" AS "mc" CROSS JOIN "total_plus_atoms" AS "t" ORDER BY "mc".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond_type", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY CASE "b".bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a1".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id2 WHEN "a2".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id END) FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "c".atom_id = "a1".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id WHERE "a1".element = 'cl' OR "a2".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) FROM "atom" AS "s" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "s".atom_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "s".molecule_id WHERE "s".element = 's' AND "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "other_a" ON "other_a".element = "a".element AND "other_a".molecule_id <> "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "other_a".atom_id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".element = 'n' AND "a".molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT "an".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "an" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "an".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "an".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "an".element = 'n' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) AS "count" FROM "atom" AS "chlorine" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "chlorine".atom_id WHERE "chlorine".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".label, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "b".molecule_id) FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '#'), 2) AS "percent" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "m".label ORDER BY "m".label ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "rare_atom" ON "rare_atom".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "rare_atom".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "rare_atom".element IN (SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) = 1) GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "atom_counts" AS (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_atoms", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'c') AS "carbon_atoms", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'cl') AS "chlorine_atoms" FROM "atom" GROUP BY molecule_id), "bond_counts" AS (SELECT "b".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_bonds", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a1".element = 'c' OR "a2".element = 'c') AS "carbon_touching_bonds", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 GROUP BY "b".molecule_id), "ranked" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label", "ac".number_of_atoms, COALESCE("bc".number_of_bonds, 0) AS "number_of_bonds", "ac".carbon_atoms, "ac".chlorine_atoms, COALESCE("bc".carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS "carbon_touching_bonds", COALESCE("bc".multiple_bonds, 0) AS "multiple_bonds", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("bc".carbon_touching_bonds, 0) DESC, "ac".number_of_atoms DESC, "m".molecule_id ASC) AS "rank" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom_counts" AS "ac" ON "ac".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond_counts" AS "bc" ON "bc".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "ac".carbon_atoms > 0) SELECT rank, molecule_id, carcinogenicity_label, number_of_atoms, number_of_bonds, carbon_atoms, chlorine_atoms, carbon_touching_bonds, multiple_bonds FROM "ranked" ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a_y" ON "a_y".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a_h" ON "a_h".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id IN (SELECT bond_id FROM "bond" WHERE molecule_id = "m".molecule_id) AND ("c".atom_id = "a_h".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a_h".atom_id) INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "a_y".element = 'y' AND "a_h".element = 'h' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(atom_bond_count), 2) FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "atom_bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "atom_degrees" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a2".element AS "element", COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "count_of_bonds" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND "a1".element = 'c' GROUP BY "a2".element ORDER BY "a2".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond_kind_symbol", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT (LEAST("a1".element, "a2".element), GREATEST("a1".element, "a2".element))) AS "element_pair_count", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY bond_count DESC, bond_kind_symbol ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb') AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id AND "b".bond_type = '-' AND "a".atom_id NOT IN (SELECT "c2".atom_id FROM "connected" AS "c2" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b2" ON "b2".bond_id = "c2".bond_id WHERE "b2".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id AND "b2".bond_type IN ('=', '#') UNION ALL SELECT "c3".atom_id2 FROM "connected" AS "c3" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b3" ON "b3".bond_id = "c3".bond_id WHERE "b3".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id AND "b3".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
